svg.title: P2p Icp Steps 3
svg.desc: Two side-by-side plots of centered triangles. In P-space, a tall triangle with its apex at about (0, 1.3) and base vertices near (±0.5, −0.65) has u sub 1 (sigma sub 1) pointing up the y sub P axis, along its long dimension, and the shorter u sub 2 (sigma sub 2) pointing along positive x sub P. In Q-space, the same triangle appears rotated about 90 degrees, with its apex at about (−1.3, 0). v sub 1 points along negative x sub Q toward that apex, and v sub 2 points along negative y sub Q, so the matching axes reveal the rotation between frames.
